title: Dina Beg Meets Wadbhag Singh at the Midway Camp

blocks.text: Dina Beg and Wadbhag Singh agree to a midway meeting, where the Nawab arrives after the Sikh leader and receives him with deliberate warmth. They sit together, exchange assurances of respect, and speak openly about Dina Beg's failure to recover his province without Khalsa support.

Dina Beg then asks for help recovering Jalandhar and says he will become Wadbhag Singh's disciple if the latter acts as his guide in the crisis. Wadbhag Singh answers that he first wants a written assurance allowing him to avenge the Pathans of Jalandhar and Kartarpur, including the destruction associated with Nasir Ali and the seizure of Muslim households.

Only after that demand is accepted does the Nawab swear an oath on the Koran and promise to keep his word. With that written assurance secured, Wadbhag Singh prepares to summon the Khalsa so the campaign can proceed as both a political alliance and a religiously charged act of vengeance.
